parameters.content:
RAYAH AUTOMATION RUNNER — PRODUCTION FINAL v3

ROOT-CAUSE FIXES:
1. Find Due parses next_run in the automation timezone
   (default Indian/Antananarivo, UTC+3) and compares in UTC.
   Naive timestamps are NO LONGER assumed to be UTC.
2. Claim / Update filters now match on the id column
   (keyName was missing before).
3. Google Chat URL collapses any spaces/spaces/ -> spaces/.
4. Merge removed — each Verify node feeds Prepare Final directly,
   so a single-branch run never stalls.
5. Success requires a verified provider response.
6. run_count is preserved (Claim no longer resets it).
7. Rows stuck in 'running' >10 min are auto-recovered.

CREDENTIALS:  Chat account 2 · Gmail account 3
Keep this workflow Published/Active.
